UpdateSourceArgs: -c "mkdir -p PEMK && if [ -d PEMK/project/.git ]; then git -C PEMK/project pull --ff-only; else git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/SamDreamsMaker/pokemon-essentials-mmo-kit.git PEMK/project; fi"
-c "cd PEMK/project/server && bundle config set --local path ../../vendor/bundle && bundle install"

-c "mkdir -p PEMK && echo  | base64 -d > PEMK/start.sh && chmod 755 PEMK/start.sh"
